title: SG-2.8 · Mocked-fs unit test checks every manifest.json path against present files
summary: Lock the outcome: a unit test with the file system mocked checks every path in the committed manifest.json against a list of present files.
description: Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json lists 14 assets. Existing tests (tests/manifestLoaderMocked.test.ts, tests/manifestDanglingMocked.test.ts) mock fs with synthetic manifests but none checks the committed manifest against a list of files. Desired behavior: a mocked-fs test reads the committed manifest and verifies every asset path is in a given list of files. Expected result: manifest and asset folders cannot drift apart unnoticed. Why: keeps manifest and assets in sync.
acceptance_criteria: Given the committed manifest.json and a file list that contains every manifest path, when the test runs, then no path is reported missing.
Given a file list lacking one manifest path, when the check runs, then exactly that path is reported missing.

in_scope: One mocked-fs unit test against the committed manifest.json
A small pure helper to compare manifest paths with a file list
preserve: Existing loadManifestFile and loadManifestWithFallback behavior and tests

technical_constraints: Vitest with vi.mock('node:fs'); no real asset directory reads in the new test
definition_of_done: Test passes and covers every committed manifest path
